purpose: Use already-known daily PRICE/INSTITUTIONAL/MARGIN path to estimate the direction of the next not-yet-published weekly TDCC ownership snapshot without synthesizing daily TDCC data.

timing.training_example: For transition Snapshot(t-1)->Snapshot(t), features use only daily data after Snapshot(t-1) through the nowcast cutoff; labels are learned only after Snapshot(t) becomes PIT-eligible.
timing.live_shadow: At any cutoff before the target snapshot reference date, use daily data since the latest observed TDCC reference date. Never use daily observations after the target snapshot date.
timing.publication_lag: TDCC remains weekly; nowcast predicts direction before publication and is not a replacement for the official snapshot.

model.reason: V0 is a shadow probability/ranking layer. Threshold promotion requires independent OOS evidence.

explicit_non_rules: No AbsorbProbability or ReleaseProbability threshold is a BUY/SELL rule in V0.
Do not infer beneficial owner, operator identity, or manipulation intent.
Do not patch the daily mother with predicted ownership.

integration.monster_v2_watch: Shadow ABSORB can rank/annotate S1 WATCH before the next official TDCC release.
integration.monster_v2_handoff: Shadow RELEASE can warn that ownership may be moving outward before the next official TDCC release.
integration.confirmation: Official TDCC remains authoritative; shadow state is replaced/verified when the next snapshot becomes PIT-eligible.
